digest.component_or_area: development process and governance audit evaluation
propositions: Six process-audit recommendations must be evaluated against prior audit decisions, implementation outcomes, and janitor work to avoid redundant or contradictory work.
Escaped-defect metadata via detected_by field exists at 1.1% coverage in current store; expand automated stamping at filer/agent boundaries rather than mandate the field globally or backfill history.

Deterministic plan preflight (P1-P11) with fail-open advisory behavior is the correct floor; extend it only for recurrent mechanically decidable failures demonstrated in persisted review/completion cohorts, not by spec-by-example or riskiest-assumption.

Completion-failure classification requires offline derivation of code-defect versus AC/test/scope/environment/verifier categories before adding durable schema; 72.3% first-pass mixing is not a homogeneous defect escape signal.

Risk-tiered review pilot should measure signals (security, store, concurrency surfaces, diff breadth, complexity, plan-review failures) without merge blocking, because the project has autonomous Gerrit review and no routine human approver; validate blocking precision before enforcement.

Autonomous governance and provider/model independence are the remaining challenges; do not add mandatory human approval or reviewer rotation, but durably distinguish author from reviewer agents, monitor provider diversity and correlated failures, and test critical-path recovery for credentials and services.
